 New Zealand suffer major blow ahead of India Test series
 Dean Foxcroft receives a call up to New Zealand's Test squad with news that Mitchell Santner will be sidelined for the two Tests with India.
 16 November, 2026 New Zealand have been hit with a massive blow with news that star all-rounder Mitchell Santner will miss the upcoming two-match ICC World Test Championship series against India.
 Santner was struck on the hand while batting during the recent fifth and final ODI against India in Mount Maunganui and scans have since revealed the 34-year-old has fractured his right hand.
 View this post on Instagram 
 It means the experienced New Zealand spinner will miss the two matches against India that commences in Wellington on Thursday, while he will be racing the clock to be fit for the start of the four-match series with Australia that starts on December 9.
 The Black Caps have called up fellow all-rounder Dean Foxcroft to their 14-player squad for the India series, with the right-arm spinner in contention to play the series opener at Basin Reserve.
 View this post on Instagram 
 New Zealand currently sit on top of the World Test Championship standings and will be looking to replicate their most recent Test series against India when they recorded an upset 3-0 series triumph over the Asian side on the sub-continent in 2024.
 New Zealand squad : Tom Latham (c), Tom Blundell, Devon Conway, Jacob Duffy, Dean Foxcroft, Matt Henry, Kyle Jamieson, Daryl Mitchell, Henry Nicholls, Glenn Phillips, Rachin Ravindra, Nathan Smith, Blair Tickner, Will Young
 Series schedule: 
 First Test : 19-24 November, Wellington
 Second Test : 27 November - 2 December, Christchurch
